purpose: DEC-054 golden for V2-M6b (DEC-069): the 14-step year-end workflow of a synthetic company's 2026 year through five phases. For each phase the control status and the state of every step were written by hand before the code, from the rules of DEC-069 and the scenario's facts.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC. The company, amounts, thresholds and review settings are test choices.

workings.bank: Bank 1200: 10,000 shares received less 3,600 laptops = 6,400 at the year end, with no bank account set up, so review control RC-08 raises it until it is explained and signed off.
workings.assets: The laptops are added from the cash payment (a linked addition), so the register reconciles to the ledger; the step needs a live depreciation run as at 31.12.2026 because an asset is active: 3,600 / 36 x 12 = 1,200.
workings.cutoff: Step 1: the draft invoice (and later the draft bill) is dated in the year. The single 2026 period covers the year.
workings.settings: Without review settings RC-05 is not evaluated, so steps 3 and 4 need attention. The settings chosen are large enough that nothing else is raised in a first year whose comparative is all zero.
workings.accounts: Step 11 reads the accounts document (a verified synthetic version without wording rules: complete) and the size test (a verified synthetic threshold set, the turnover line P.T, one employee, the company's first year): MICRO, and MICRO is chosen, so it fits.
workings.lapse: Phase 5: a draft bill dated 15.12.2026 makes step 1's control need attention again; its sign-off lapses. Steps 2 to 11 keep their own controls and stay DONE. Step 9 reopened: its dependency (step 1) is not DONE, so it is BLOCKED.

revisions: 2026-10-21, V2-M6c (DEC-070): steps 12 to 14 are no longer LATER. Step 12 (partner review) depends on steps 1 to 11, and its control is READY because the accounts document is complete: TODO in phase 4, BLOCKED otherwise. Step 13 (client approval) needs attention: no live partner review, the 2026 period is open and the approval facts are not set. Step 14 (the package) needs attention: no client approval. Both are BLOCKED. Signing off step 12 through the workflow is refused as step_own_record (was step_later). Steps 1 to 11 and the current step of every phase are unchanged. The V2-M6b acceptance evidence at 9868fbc stands as recorded.
